text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After wrapping up training with <chrname>, 
I head over to Azuma-san, who had been 
watching. 
And then---...

text_block_list.name: Azuma
text_block_list.text:
............May human and horsegirl 
ever abide in harmony and peace.

text_block_list.name: Azuma
text_block_list.text:
May boundless fortune visit the pair 
standing here, 
and may prosperity grant them eternal 
grace... 
--------Humbly and reverently do I pray.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...So fervent was her prayer that she 
didn't 
even notice my approach. 
The deep devotion in her heart filled me 
with warmth.
